_note: supervision-plan-page REQ (vth-module, board DqToezichtplan): a year's supervision plan and its category rows. The plan holds the year and the capacity in hours; a category row holds what is planned for one kind of supervision (hospitality, construction, environment), the hours one inspection takes and how often each risk profile is visited. Completed and cancelled are NOT stored here: they are counted from the field inspections that name the category in `planCategory`, so an inspection completed in the field counts at once without anyone editing the plan (SupervisionPlanProgress). A field inspection is cancelled when it carries `cancelledAt`; its offline `status` stays the device's lifecycle.

supervisionPlan.title: Supervision plan
supervisionPlan.description: The annual supervision plan: the year it covers and the inspection capacity available for it.

title.title: Title
title.description: The plan's name, such as Supervision plan 2026.

year.title: Year
year.description: The calendar year the plan covers.

description.title: Description
description.description: What the plan sets out to inspect, in one or two sentences.

capacityHours.title: Capacity (hours)
capacityHours.description: The inspection hours available in the year, set against the demand the categories' risk frequencies ask for.

supervisionPlanCategory.title: Supervision plan category
supervisionPlanCategory.description: One category of a supervision plan: how many inspections are planned, the hours one takes and how often each risk profile is visited.

plan.title: Plan
plan.description: The supervision plan this category belongs to.

planned.title: Planned inspections
planned.description: The number of inspections planned in this category for the plan's year.

hoursPerInspection.title: Hours per inspection
hoursPerInspection.description: The hours one inspection in this category takes, travel included.

riskFrequency.title: Frequency by risk
riskFrequency.description: How often an object of each risk profile is inspected: the number of objects with that profile and the visits per object per year.

profile.title: Risk profile
profile.description: The risk profile of the objects in this row.

objects.title: Objects
objects.description: How many objects carry this risk profile.

visitsPerYear.title: Visits per year
visitsPerYear.description: Inspections per object per year; 0.5 is once every two years.

order.title: Order
order.description: Where the category stands among the plan's categories.

planCategory.title: Plan category
planCategory.description: The supervision plan category this inspection counts towards. Empty for an inspection outside any plan.

cancelledAt.title: Cancelled at
cancelledAt.description: When the inspection was cancelled. A cancelled inspection counts as cancelled in its plan category, not as remaining.
